title: Panel Discussion: Investment Landscape & Financing Opportunities​
gist: This is a member-only video page for a Benchmark Summit 2026 London panel on investment and financing for battery, EV and critical-minerals projects. Panelists come from Benchmark's indexing and derivatives team, the Church of England Pensions Board, Siemens Financial Services, the Global Battery Alliance's battery passport and Appian Capital Advisory. The page gives no content beyond the panel's remit and its line-up.

insights.claim: A Benchmark Summit 2026 London panel on funding trends, investment strategies and financing for battery, EV and critical-minerals projects included Daniel Fletcher-Manuel (Benchmark indexing and derivatives), Adam Matthews (Church of England Pensions Board), Pedro Valle-e-Azevedo (Siemens Financial Services), Graham Lee (Global Battery Alliance) and Richard Clarke (Appian Capital Advisory).
insights.speaker: Daniel Fletcher-Manuel , Director of Indexing & Derivatives , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Adam Matthews , Chief Resp
insights.so_what: The capital sources on show span pension funds, corporate finance and mining private equity, which shows the range of financiers being courted.
insights.quote: Exploring funding trends, investment strategies, and financing solutions to support battery, EV, and critical minerals projects.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Investment Landscape & Financing Opportunities

insights.claim: Benchmark put its Director of Indexing & Derivatives on a financing panel, which suggests price indices and derivatives are being presented as tools to make battery-materials projects bankable.
insights.speaker: Daniel Fletcher-Manuel , Director of Indexing & Derivatives , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Adam Matthews , Chief Resp
insights.so_what: Better hedging instruments for battery metals could lower the cost of financing projects and are worth tracking as a market-structure development.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Investment Landscape & Financing Opportunities

insights.claim: The financing panel included the Global Battery Alliance's Head of Battery Passport and a responsible-investment officer from the Church of England Pensions Board, which places traceability and responsible-investment criteria inside the financing discussion.
insights.speaker: Daniel Fletcher-Manuel , Director of Indexing & Derivatives , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Adam Matthews , Chief Resp
insights.so_what: Traceability via battery passports and ESG screens may increasingly decide which battery-materials projects get capital.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Investment Landscape & Financing Opportunities

insights.claim: Benchmark's related-session listing says the role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest, with senior EV analyst George Whitcombe discussing it with senior editor Matthew Bird.
insights.speaker: Daniel Fletcher-Manuel , Director of Indexing & Derivatives , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Adam Matthews , Chief Resp
insights.so_what: Chinese OEM share gains in European EVs are a watch item for European automakers and for which regions the battery supply chain serves.
insights.quote: The role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest.
insights.locator: China's role in Europe EV market
